title: Enforcement Guidance on Harassment in the Workplace
statusNote: Approved by the Commission on April 29, 2024 by a 3-2 vote, replacing the 1999 vicarious liability guidance and several other earlier documents. Portions were declared unlawful and vacated nationwide on May 15, 2025 in Texas, et al. v. EEOC. The Commission then voted 2-1 on January 22, 2026 to rescind the guidance, announced January 23, 2026. Nothing was issued in its place. It is recorded here because the document it replaced points at it, and because a reader must not assume a current EEOC enforcement guidance on workplace harassment exists.
claims: This document was approved by the Commission on April 29, 2024 by a 3-2 vote.
This document replaced the Enforcement Guidance on Vicarious Employer Liability for Unlawful Harassment by Supervisors, issued in 1999, along with several other earlier EEOC guidance documents.

On May 15, 2025 a federal court in Texas, et al. v. EEOC declared unlawful and vacated portions of this document as contrary to law, and the court stated that its vacatur of the unlawful portions applies nationwide.
